description: This file defines an abstract class 'MonkeyEvent' representing various types of events used in Android's 'monkey' testing tool. It specifies event types, associated constants, and an abstract method for injecting events, serving as a base class for concrete event implementations.

classes.name: MonkeyEvent
classes.description: Abstract class that models a generic event in the Android Monkey testing framework, providing properties and abstract behavior for specific event types.

methods.name: MonkeyEvent
methods.description: Constructor that sets the event type.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Indicates whether the event can be followed by a throttle delay.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to inject the event into the system; must be implemented by subclasses.
